bus.unused_bits: ignored by codec and controller; physical assumption to check

environment.parent_law: rate_s_per_word=48*r(t)*p_s/s; uniform size-s subset of 48 positions; words independent in conditional model
environment.p_s_meaning: fraction of bit-hit exposure attributed to parent size s, not frequency among parents
environment.projection: hypergeometric active j out of n39/n44; lambda_j=r*sum_s48*p_s/s*Pr(j|s)

conditional_sensitivity.other_sizes: 0 only in this declared sensitivity slice

initial.paid_initialization: W encodes + 3W x16 writes before t=0; separately reported and amortized over T

application.write: full useful32 write; read/decode old full word, encode/write new full word

service.application_rule: correctable old snapshot observed before modification; no service-created errors
service.point_status: conditional numerical point, not measured hardware
service.bus_reservation: decode/encode latency included in serial bus reservation; no overlap discount
service.correction: E: old births removed, new births preserved; no created error relative to new payload

constraints.clock_and_reserve: conditional common clock bounds in service

observation.fixed_monitor_price_policy: no adaptive observation/cuts/records for fixed; common app and fixed timing hardware charged separately
observation.veto_scope: raw confirmations with new G after restoration are not bounded by episode/recovery count
observation.extra_source_veto_parameter: v=E[N_v]/T per second; range[0,250002500.1], no physical selected rate
observation.veto_zero_slice: explicit conditional slice only; also report unconstrained hard upper
logical_ERR_sources: full premodification read of useful write
observation.ordinary_app_read: decode data only, no repair and no ERR/G publication

adaptive.family: two-stage own ERR, equality FAST; same-edge veto, preserved holds/phase/pending
adaptive.selection: largest k in [3,5,9,27] with NEW T196(7)/T119 interval upper<=epsilon/2
adaptive.risk_basis: T196(7), new W/ell/phase/cross directed certificate; mandatory-only row kept diagnostic
adaptive.all_history: controller and accounting continue after first exceedance
adaptive.multiword_parent_fraction: 0 only in declared independent-word conditional model

fixed.selection: largest integer k>=1 with conditional E moment upper<=epsilon/2; P=k*W*g

cost.scope: whole horizon, never stop accounting at first exceedance
cost.fixed_observation: omitted because unused; timer/controller costs stay explicit
cost.source_veto_count_coefficient: T196(11), full started work; no handler changes
cost.repair_count_bound: parent count before global bad event + Q_upper*hard reads afterwards; also always-E upper
cost.adaptive_good_source_bound: <=2 publications/parent including weak-E aperture repeat; app-read emits none; after bad history pay hard

risk_budget.metric: first weight>t in any full codeword at any time in [0,T]
risk_budget.scope: conditional on environment class and clean initial state; common bound on all required service/execution exceptions
risk_budget.quota_evidence: explicit conditional model premise, not hardware measurement

calendar.mandatory: startup full fast pass; then every kth full pass; fixed predetermined support
calendar.additional_adaptive_reads: only at unchanged potential starts; cannot suppress mandatory support

adaptive_override.mandatory: first W indices and index mod k_a=0
adaptive_override.reason: T119 phase-exposure calendar; fixed diagnostic calendar unchanged
